{{Top|leg}}
'''Puffers''' were a type of food which wriggled around before being eaten suggesting it was possible a creature eaten live. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Grelb]] ate a puffer in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] while en route to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The following day he compared the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to the puffer and the way it wriggled while the [[Human/Legends|Human]] was trapped on a cliff face trying to avoid fire from the Hutt's [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] thugs on an [[Unidentified blue marble planet|unidentified planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Puffers were first mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]'' by author [[Dave Wolverton]]. The meal has not been referenced in any other material to date.
